kit.method: pacman -Sp (URLs only) against existing sync dbs -> curl into pkgs/ -> sha256 vs %SHA256SUM% in /var/lib/pacman/sync/cachyos-extra-v3.db -> bsdtar extract (no dot-files). No root, no pacman -S/-U, no writes under /etc /usr /var.

packages.name: xorg-xwayland
packages.note: system copy is the same version and byte-identical Xwayland (61e2ffd4...); wlroots uses /usr/bin/Xwayland

unavailable.wlrctl: not in sync dbs (AUR only); replaced by bin/seatctl (minimal zwlr_virtual_pointer_v1 + zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1 client bound to a named wl_seat)

landlock-scope.what: exec under a Landlock domain scoped for abstract unix sockets + signals (ABI >= 6; host kernel ABI 10)

seatctl.usage: seatctl --list | seatctl --seat NAME [--extent W H] [--move X Y] [--click] [--type TEXT] [--hold MS]

seatprobe.usage: seatprobe TITLE SECONDS  (xdg_toplevel; logs per-seat pointer/keyboard events as JSON lines)

kit.disk: kit ~12 MB (pkgs 6 MB + extracted root + sources)

session_script.payload_env: the payload is exec'd by the private sway and inherits WAYLAND_DISPLAY (private wayland-1), SWAYSOCK (private), DISPLAY (private Xwayland, a number the host does not use, currently :3), DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS (private), XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/HOME/TMPDIR under <run>, CUA_SWAY_RUN=<run>, CUA_LANDLOCK_SCOPE=abstract-unix,signal
session_script.stdout_stderr_rc: payload stdout/stderr go to the caller; exit code of the session = payload exit code (97 refusal, 98 readiness failed, 99 sway died early)
refuses: WAYLAND_DISPLAY/WAYLAND_SOCKET or any HYPRLAND_* set (SOURCE: not executed, to avoid setting those variables)
private Xwayland display number collides with a host display (guard in payload)
session_script.readiness: N active outputs + N seats in swaymsg + xdpyinfo on DISPLAY, polled up to 30 s
session_script.teardown: payload ends -> swaymsg exit -> dbus-run-session ends -> bwrap PID namespace dies, killing exactly the session tree (0 leftover processes measured); watchdog kills sway after CUA_SWAY_TIMEOUT
session_script.run_dirs: /mnt/zer0models/cua-lane-tmp/sway-session.XXXXXX (left behind; contain absolute paths, sanitize before copying)
gotchas: Run from the worktree directory you want as the payload cwd (the script records $PWD).
CUA_SESSION_ATSPI=1 is forwarded into the scrubbed env by this script (unlike cua-x11-session.sh, which needs CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV too).
Virtual devices are attached to the seat passed at creation; a runtime 'swaymsg seat ...' re-applies attachment rules and moves them to the fallback seat0.
Freshly created virtual devices: clients bind wl_pointer/wl_keyboard after the capability event and miss earlier events; wait ~250 ms (seatctl does) or hold devices for the session.

The private D-Bus activates host-installed portal backends (xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland started and failed: no compositor reachable from the dbus-daemon environment). Harmless; no route to the host compositor exists.
Network namespace is shared on purpose (Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434 stays reachable); abstract sockets are fenced by Landlock instead.
